name: Cuartag Mhòr a’ Chuain
text: Cuartag Mhòr a’ Chuain is a Scottish Gaelic epithet. The phrase means the great whirlpool of the sea. Gaelic story pins this name on Cirein Croin, the monstrous sea-beast of lore. Tales give that beast a bulk big enough to fill the ocean. This entry records the epithet and its gloss.

attributes.attribute: a Scottish Gaelic epithet of the sea-beast
glossed as the great whirlpool of the sea

okr.objective: Cuartag Mhòr a’ Chuain records the Gaelic epithet of the sea-beast Cirein Croin.
key_results: The phrase is Scottish Gaelic for the great whirlpool of the sea.
